title: The two minute fix
premise: In a coffee shop Marcus offers to fix a stranger's frozen laptop and her boyfriend sends him to another table. Six months later she slides the laptop over to him herself.

shots.image_prompt: close shot, chest up, a sunny corner coffee shop with small round wooden tables by a big window, bright late-morning light, {marcus}, in a faded green hoodie with an old scratched laptop under his arm, bending toward the table with two fingers held up and an eager helpful smile, eyebrows high, nodding, mouth open mid-sentence. Vertical composition, no text anywhere in the image.
shots.motion_prompt: Marcus holds up two fingers and leans in, his mouth moving as he says it hopefully, nodding at the laptop. Quick push-in on his eager face.
shots.speaker: marcus
